title: CHAPTER 11: PRACTICE QUESTIONS AND MOCK TEST

blocks.content: 11.1 Maharashtra History – Practice Questions

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Section 11.1 covers Maharashtra History Practice Questions.
Section 11.2 contains Geography Practice Questions.
Section 11.3 focuses on Polity and Governance Practice Questions.
Section 11.4 provides Culture and Heritage Practice Questions.

blocks.content: The following questions are representative of the type asked in MPSC SI and PSC examinations. Practice these to test your preparation.

items: Who is considered the 'Father of Indian Unrest' by British authorities?

blocks.content: Answer: Bal Gangadhar Tilak (Lokmanya Tilak)

items: In which year did Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj's Rajyabhishek (coronation) take place?

blocks.content: Answer: 1674 CE (6 June 1674 at Raigad Fort)

items: Who performed the Rajyabhishek ceremony of Shivaji Maharaj?

blocks.content: Answer: Gaga Bhatt (Vishweshwar Bhatt), a scholar from Varanasi

items: Which fort was the birthplace of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj?

blocks.content: Answer: Shivneri Fort, near Junnar, Pune district

items: The Satyashodhak Samaj was founded by whom and in which year?

blocks.content: Answer: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule, in 1873

items: Which battle is known for the killing of Afzal Khan?

blocks.content: Answer: Battle of Pratapgad (1659)

items: Who was the first Chief Minister of Maharashtra?

blocks.content: Answer: Yashwantrao Chavan (1960)

items: Maharashtra was formed on which date and year?

blocks.content: Answer: 1 May 1960 (Maharashtra Day)

items: The Mahad Satyagraha (1927) was led by which leader?

blocks.content: Answer: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar; it was a satyagraha for the right of untouchables to draw water from a public tank in Mahad, Raigad

items: In which year did the Latur earthquake occur and what was its approximate magnitude?

blocks.content: Answer: 30 September 1993; magnitude approximately 6.2 on the Richter scale
11.2 Geography Practice Questions
CHAPTER 11: PRACTICE QUESTIONS AND MOCK TEST

items: Which is the highest peak in Maharashtra and where is it located?

blocks.content: Answer: Kalsubai (1646 metres); located in Ahmednagar district

items: On which river is the Koyna Dam built and in which district?

blocks.content: Answer: Koyna River; Satara district

items: Which city is known as the 'Orange City' of India?

blocks.content: Answer: Nagpur

items: Where does the river Godavari originate?

blocks.content: Answer: At Trimbakeshwar in Nashik district (at an altitude of about 721 metres)

items: Which coastal region of Maharashtra is known for Alphonso mangoes?

blocks.content: Answer: Konkan region (especially Ratnagiri and Sindhudurg districts)

items: The Tadoba-Andhari Tiger Reserve is in which district?

blocks.content: Answer: Chandrapur district

items: Which district of Maharashtra receives the highest rainfall?

blocks.content: Answer: Sindhudurg district (specifically Amboli ghat) and Satara district (Mahabaleshwar) are highest – Mahabaleshwar station records about 6250 mm

items: Name the sea bridge that connects Mumbai to Navi Mumbai, inaugurated in 2024.

blocks.content: Answer: Atal Setu (Mumbai Trans Harbour Link); 21.8 km; inaugurated January 2024
11.3 Polity and Governance Practice Questions

items: How many seats does Maharashtra have in the Lok Sabha?

blocks.content: Answer: 48 seats (the highest among all states)

items: Which is the largest Municipal Corporation in India by budget?

blocks.content: Answer: Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC / MCGM)

items: Under which Article of the Constitution are special provisions made for Maharashtra and Gujarat?

blocks.content: Answer: Article 371(2)

items: How many members are there in the Maharashtra Vidhan Parishad (Legislative Council)?

blocks.content: Answer: 78 members

items: The Maharashtra Control of Organised Crime Act (MCOCA) was enacted in which year?

blocks.content: Answer: 1999
11.4 Culture and Heritage Practice Questions

items: Maharashtra History and Geography form primary subsections in practice mock tests.
Polity, Governance, and Regional Culture are heavily emphasized across question sets.
Where are the Ajanta Caves located and when were they designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site?

blocks.content: Answer: Ajanta Caves are in Aurangabad district; designated as UNESCO WHS in 1983

items: The Pandharpur temple is dedicated to which deity?

blocks.content: Answer: Vitthal (Vithoba / Pandurang)

items: Who started the public celebration of Ganeshotsav (Ganesh festival) to bring people together during the freedom movement?

blocks.content: Answer: Bal Gangadhar Tilak (Lokmanya Tilak) in 1893

items: What is Maharashtra's state animal?

blocks.content: Answer: Giant Indian Squirrel (Shekru / Ratufa indica)

items: The Kailasa Temple at Ellora was built during which dynasty's reign?

blocks.content: Answer: Rashtrakuta dynasty (especially under Dantidurga and Krishna I, 8th century CE)
